description.value: Sweethoney Dessert is a Hong Kong dessert chain with a Burnaby franchise offering handcrafted traditional desserts made fresh in-store, including mango pomelo sago, tofu pudding, and housemade grass jelly. The chain was founded to bring authentic Hong Kong dessert culture to North America using premium, natural ingredients. It is one of several BC locations and markets itself as a relaxed gathering spot.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces, covered) at 30m; stands (8 spaces) at 58m. Total: 14 spaces.
